sentences.text:
2023
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Surender
 Criminal Petition No.11381 Of 2023
Order:

This Criminal Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 is filed by the petitioners/A2 to A5 to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.20 of 2023 of Women Police Station, Khammam District, registered for the offences under Sections 498A of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor, on written instructions, dated 17.11.2023, would submit that in the subject case, investigation is completed, charge sheet is filed before the Court concerned and C.C.No.335 of 2023 is also assigned.
4.
Under these circumstances, nothing survives for adjudication in this Criminal Petition.
5. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is dismissed as infructuous.
However, liberty is granted to the petitioners to work out the remedies available under law.
Miscellaneous applications pending, if any, shall stand closed.
